description: Run a command from the app's menus by its path, as find_command lists it ("File ▸ Export As PDF…", "Format > Font > Bold"). It is pressed through accessibility with the app in the background: no menu opens and the user is not disturbed. A command the app greys out only while it is inactive briefly brings the app forward while the user is idle (handed back right after); one that is greyed out anyway fails (it needs a selection, a document or another window). Requires a prior observe_app for this app in this session. Call observe_app afterwards to verify the result.

app.description: Target app: its name as listed by find_apps, its id (bundle id / executable name), or its absolute path.

command.description: The command as find_command lists it, without the shortcut: "File ▸ Export As PDF…" (">" also separates; case and a trailing "…" do not matter).

name: run_command
title: Run a menu command
